summary.headline: Pyramid Technoplast Q2 FY27 revenue up 48% YoY to Rs 238 crore, EBITDA up 61% to Rs 20.3 crore, with EBITDA/ton at Rs 13,718.
summary.overview: Q2 FY27 was a volume-recovery quarter: volume rose 21% YoY and 14% QoQ to about 14,798 MT, with capacity utilisation near 70% against 62% in Q1 FY27. Average realisation rose about 22% YoY to about Rs 1.61 lakh per ton, and management stressed EBITDA per ton (up 33% YoY) over margin. EBITDA margin was 8.5% versus 7.8% a year ago, and PAT margin about 4%. H1 revenue rose 42% YoY, while H1 EBITDA margin was about 9%, and management reiterated FY27 guidance of about 15% revenue growth and 11-12% EBITDA margin, including about 1.5 points from subsidy. Capex is cut to about Rs 20-25 crore in FY27 from about Rs 90 crore in FY26.

segments.name: Polymer drums
segments.commentary: Tonnage rose 5% YoY and 16% QoQ in Q2 FY27; H1 revenue about Rs 204 crore.

segments.name: IBC (intermediate bulk containers)
segments.commentary: Units grew 17% YoY; about 32% of Q2 revenue; H1 revenue about Rs 150 crore.

segments.name: MS drums
segments.commentary: Tonnage grew 73% YoY; H1 revenue about Rs 64 crore.

segments.name: Recycling plant
segments.commentary: Commissioned October 2025 (investment Rs 8-10 crore); generated Rs 33 lakh EBITDA in Q2 FY27 and is guided to about Rs 2 crore EBITDA in FY27.

segments.name: Paint-industry machine
segments.commentary: Commercial production started October 2025 with about Rs 70 lakh revenue in its first month.

guidance_outlook: FY27 guidance: about 15% revenue growth and EBITDA margin of 11-12%; management says roughly 9.5% from operations plus 1.5 points from subsidy.
H1 EBITDA about Rs 41 crore; management expects about Rs 45 crore in H2 FY27.
Utilisation target about 80% for FY27 (later framed as 75-80%); Kutch facility of about 10,000 IBCs per month to be commissioned by March 2027 at Rs 20-25 crore.
WADA and BHARUCH subsidies total about Rs 35 crore (WADA Rs 24.9 crore over 10 years; BHARUCH Rs 10.5 crore); management cited about Rs 3-4 crore a year hitting the bottom line.
Remaining 1 MW solar expected to start benefit next month; FY27 capex about Rs 20-25 crore versus about Rs 90 crore in FY26.
capex_capacity: Installed capacity about 20,993 MT per quarter; Q2 volume 14,798 MT (about 70% utilisation); H1 volume 27,789 MT at about 66% average utilisation.
New Kutch facility: about 10,000 IBCs per month, Rs 20-25 crore, targeted for commissioning by March 2027; aims to cut freight and speed delivery in Kutch and Western India.
WADA facility running across SDP drums, IBCs and MS drums; WADA capacity expansion to take about 6 months and to start after March 2027 (subsidy-linked).

Solar: 6 MW and 2.25 MW commissioned October 2025, 5 MW at Bharuch February 2026, 1 MW more pending; total 14.25 MW for about Rs 15 crore annual savings on Rs 60 crore investment (about 4-year payback). About Rs 3.89 crore savings achieved in H1 FY27; management says about 80-90% of planned solar benefit is flowing.
Recycling plant reached 25% of processing; management expects the next 75% within 3-4 months.
demand_pricing: Management says demand and volumes are rising quarter on quarter and in the current month; over 500 customers, top customer about 6% of revenue, top 10 about 29%.

Blended realisation about Rs 33-35 per kg; management says it earns the usual Rs 20-22 per kg gross spread, and expects Rs 35/kg to hold even if polymer prices fall, since raw material is passed through.
Q2 revenue bridge: realisation contributed about Rs 43.6 crore, volume and product mix about Rs 24.9 crore, and trading income about Rs 8.7 crore of the Rs 77 crore increase.

Other expenses rose to about Rs 19/kg from Rs 17/kg, which management attributed to long-distance transport for pan-India customers, labour changes, and staff returning to full strength after holidays.
Raw material sourcing now about 80% local after Hormuz-related import halt.

qa_highlights.question: H1 revenue is well above the FY27 guidance, but margin is about 9%. How will it reach 11%?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said margin would reach about 9.5% from operations, with 1.5 points from subsidy, for about 11%.

qa_highlights.question: Why did other expenses rise sharply, and can transport costs be passed on?
qa_highlights.answer: Management attributed about Rs 2 crore of the sequential increase to long-distance transport and cited employee costs from staff returning from holidays; said transport is priced into customer rates and the Kutch plant should cut freight.

qa_highlights.question: Why is cash flow negative in H1, and how does it accumulate by year-end?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said imports stopped after the Hormuz issue, purchases are about 80% local, and debtors rose from about Rs 23 crore to Rs 33 crore as sales increased; said the outflow reflects business investment.

qa_highlights.question: Is FY27 revenue guidance of 15% conservative?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it tries to be conservative, and that volumes are growing month on month, with utilisation to reach 75-80% and possible additional machines.

qa_highlights.question: What is the recycling plant's contribution and when will solar benefits fully flow?
qa_highlights.answer: Recycling is expected to add about Rs 2 crore in FY27 and Rs 4-5 crore in the following year; solar savings were about 80-90% of plan, with the remaining 1 MW starting next month.

risks_watch: Margin bridge depends on subsidy (about 1.5 points) and H2 operating leverage; ex-subsidy margin is about 9.5% in H1.
Other expenses per kg rose to about Rs 19 from Rs 17; management had not fully reconciled the increase on the call and said it would check.
Working capital: debtors up to about Rs 33 crore and H1 cash flow negative; some figures cited in the call (interest, advance tax, debt repayment) were left to be confirmed offline.
Utilisation still about 70% versus the earlier 80% FY27 target; FY27 target now cited as 75-80%.
Subsidy timing depends on WADA sanction by March 2027; the BHARUCH application is still to be filed.
Chemical-industry end-demand: management attributes volume growth to chemicals, and the company has not yet split food and pharma revenue within IBCs.
summary.management_tone: Confident on volume, pricing and EBITDA per ton, but evasive on specifics: several numbers (other-expense bridge, interest, advance tax, debt repayment, IBC food share) were deferred to offline follow-up. Management also reiterated the 11-12% margin guide while H1 stood at 9%.

FY27 and the years ahead are about filling that capacity and converting it into stronger earnings and revenue group and returns.

growth.why: FY27 guidance of ~15% revenue growth is held, with H1 revenue already up 42% YoY, volumes rising QoQ, and utilisation moving from 62% to 70%; backing is partial, mainly the Kutch IBC facility (~10,000 IBCs/month, Rs 20-25 crore, due by March 2027) plus realisation and mix, while the 80% utilisation target was cut to 75-80% and FY27 capex is down to Rs 20-25 crore from Rs 90 crore.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: H1 EBITDA margin about 9% with H2 EBITDA guided to about Rs 45 crore, and FY27 guide of 11-12% includes about 1.5 points from subsidy (Rs 3-4 crore a year); ex-subsidy margin is still about 9.5%, so the step-up depends on H2 operating leverage and subsidy booking.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: New Kutch facility of about 10,000 IBCs per month (Rs 20-25 crore) is targeted for commissioning by March 2027, while installed capacity is about 20,993 MT per quarter and Q2 utilisation is only about 70%.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Q2 volume rose 21% YoY and 14% QoQ to 14,798 MT, management says volumes are rising QoQ and in the current month, and utilisation moved from 62% to 70%, with a 75-80% FY27 target.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Utilisation is about 70% with headroom still available, and FY27 capex is cut to Rs 20-25 crore from about Rs 90 crore; management mentioned possible additional machines and WADA expansion (about 6 months, after March 2027) is subsidy-linked, so a fresh major capex is not firmly signalled.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: H1 revenue is up 42% YoY against FY27 guidance of about 15%, but management held the 15% guide and H1 EBITDA margin of about 9% sits well below the 11-12% target, so an upgrade is not signalled.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: The 11-12% EBITDA margin guide still needs H2 margin far above the 9% H1 level, the utilisation target was cut to 75-80% from 80%, and the subsidy depends on WADA sanction by March 2027 with BHARUCH not yet filed.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: Recycling plant (25% of processing reached, next 75% in 3-4 months) and paint-industry machine (about Rs 70 lakh first-month revenue) are ramping, but no new product or brand launch is firmly dated.

rows.label: Solar savings ramp to about Rs 15 crore a year
rows.why: Solar savings are about 80-90% of plan with Rs 3.89 crore achieved in H1 FY27 and the remaining 1 MW starting next month, against about Rs 15 crore annual run-rate on 14.25 MW.

rows.label: Working capital and H1 negative cash flow
rows.why: Debtors rose from about Rs 23 crore to Rs 33 crore and H1 cash flow was negative, with management attributing it to business investment and some figures deferred offline.

rows.label: Other-expense rise passed to customers
rows.why: Other expenses rose to about Rs 19/kg from Rs 17/kg (about Rs 2 crore sequential), management says transport is priced into customer rates and Kutch should cut freight, but the bridge was not fully reconciled.
